title: Peak adaptation memory
caption: Training fit is a peak live-memory problem across resident weights, trainable state, activations and workspace, not a comparison of weight bytes with installed RAM.

symbols.name: peak adaptation memory
symbols.meaning: maximum live working memory required by an adaptation window

symbols.name: resident weight memory
symbols.meaning: frozen backbone weights that must reside in working memory

symbols.name: trainable state memory
symbols.meaning: trainable parameters plus their gradients and optimizer state

symbols.name: activation memory
symbols.meaning: saved activations live at time t in the execution schedule

symbols.name: operator workspace
symbols.meaning: temporary execution buffers live at time t

title: Background adaptation admission
latex: E_{\mathrm{win}}\le E_{\mathrm{allow}}\quad\land\quad P_{\mathrm{dev}}+\Delta P_{\mathrm{adapt}}\le P_{\mathrm{thermal}}\quad\land\quad L_{\mathrm{fg}}+\Delta L_{\mathrm{adapt}}\le D_{\mathrm{fg}}
caption: A background update is admitted only when predicted energy, sustained power and foreground-latency impact all fit their separate budgets. Charging relaxes only the energy term.

symbols.name: window energy
symbols.meaning: predicted energy consumed by one adaptation window

symbols.name: energy allowance
symbols.meaning: energy policy permits before the next charging opportunity

symbols.name: sustained power with adaptation
symbols.meaning: current device power plus the adaptation increment

symbols.name: thermal power limit
symbols.meaning: sustained power the device can dissipate without throttling or discomfort

symbols.name: foreground latency with adaptation
symbols.meaning: measured foreground latency plus worst-case contention increase

symbols.name: foreground deadline
symbols.meaning: user-facing latency deadline that background learning may not consume

title: Low-rank update parameters
caption: LoRA trains two thin matrices rather than the full matrix. The saving applies to trainable parameters; backward traversal, activations and optimizer state still need accounting.

symbols.name: adapter rank
symbols.meaning: rank or bottleneck width of the low-rank update

symbols.name: input dimension
symbols.meaning: input width of the adapted matrix

symbols.name: output dimension
symbols.meaning: output width of the adapted matrix

symbols.name: LoRA trainable parameters
symbols.meaning: parameters in the down- and up-projections

symbols.name: full matrix parameters
symbols.meaning: parameters exposed by full fine-tuning

title: Federated averaging
caption: FedAvg forms an example-weighted average of returned client models. The weighting rule is a population policy, not a neutral implementation detail.

symbols.name: next global model
symbols.meaning: shared model after round t aggregation

symbols.name: client model
symbols.meaning: model returned by client k after local training

symbols.name: client sample count
symbols.meaning: number of examples used by client k

symbols.name: participating clients
symbols.meaning: clients whose updates completed and were accepted in the round

title: Measured time to target
caption: Local epochs are compared by measured time to a validated quality target, including round duration and completion, rather than by communication rounds alone.

symbols.name: local epochs
symbols.meaning: number of local epochs each client performs per round

symbols.name: rounds to target
symbols.meaning: first validated round count reaching the declared quality target

symbols.name: round duration
symbols.meaning: observed duration of selection, local work, transfer, aggregation and waiting

symbols.name: time to target
symbols.meaning: elapsed wall-clock time to the validated target under a candidate local-work setting

title: Federated round traffic
caption: A round pays download, upload, protocol and retry traffic. Compressed uploads alone do not establish end-to-end communication savings.

symbols.name: round communication volume
symbols.meaning: total bytes transferred by one federated round

symbols.name: download volume
symbols.meaning: global-model bytes sent to participating clients

symbols.name: upload volume
symbols.meaning: client update bytes returned to the coordinator

symbols.name: protocol volume
symbols.meaning: control, cryptographic and aggregation-protocol bytes

symbols.name: retry volume
symbols.meaning: retransmission and recovery bytes caused by interruption or dropout
